decisions.source_evidence: Not visible. Every panel starts at the line 'לא־החזיק לעד אפו…'. Only the bottoms of vowels from the line above (the one with מי־אל כמוך) show at the top edge. Cannot be checked from these panels.
Not visible. Same cut-off line as 134; only the bottoms of vowels show at the top of panels 0-0 and 0-1.

Panel 0-0, line 2 'חָפֵץ חֶסֶד הוּא'. A short separate vertical stroke sits just left of the segol under ח, before the segol under ס. It is separate from the segol dots and looks like the same mark as in id 138.
Panel 0-0, end of line 2. A short vertical stroke sits left of the two tsere dots under מ, before נ. It is separate from the tsere and is not the qamats-shaped mark under ח in the line above.

Panels 0-1 and 1-1, last line 'חֶסֶד לְאַבְרָהָם'. The marks under the word read segol, a short vertical stroke, then segol. The stroke stands apart from both triangles of dots. It shows best in panel 1-1.

The word spans the edge between panel 1-1 (right part) and panels 0-0 and 1-0 (…שְׁבַּעְתָּ). Reading right to left: sheva under שׁ, patah bar under ב, a short vertical stroke, sheva under ע, then the qamats T under ת. The stroke is separate from the patah bar and from the qamats stem.

Panels 0-0 and 1-0, last line. A short vertical stroke sits just left of the tsere under ת, under the yod. It is near the space before מִימֵי. This is moderate confidence: it's close to the next word, but its position fits a meteg on ת rather than any mark on מ.

Panels 0-0 and 1-0, last line. Under the first מ there is a hiriq dot. I can't clearly separate a stroke after it from the stroke I gave to לַאֲבֹתֵֽינוּ (id 140) at the edge of the neighbouring word. Needs a tighter crop.
Panels 0-0 and 1-0, last word before the rule. The marks under it read segol under ק, a short vertical stroke, then segol under ד. The stroke is separate from the dots and from the ק descender.

unresolved.reason: Its line (מִי־אֵל כָּמוֹךָ…) is above the top edge of all four panels. A panel covering the first line of Tashlikh below the rule is needed.
Same line as 134 (…וְעֹבֵר עַל־פֶּשַׁע…); not in the panels.
A possible stroke after the hiriq of מִימֵי can't be told apart from the meteg I assigned to לַאֲבֹתֵֽינוּ next to it. Needs a tighter crop of the start of the last line.
